summary: Guyana has no published post-quantum policy, standard or migration plan. The only institutional material on record is a government announcement reporting that the cybersecurity team of the National Data Management Authority placed eighteenth, inside the top twenty, at the CyberQ: Security in the Quantum Era hackathon hosted in the United Arab Emirates, an event covering post-quantum cryptography, quantum key distribution and quantum-safe migration strategies. That places the country at the level of nascent technical skills rather than institutional commitment. No lead agency has been given a quantum-safe mandate, no algorithm suite or standards family has been adopted, and no migration timeline or completion date has been set.
